$comment: Safeguards are constraints, not features. A product cannot ship a screen that violates one. tools/validate.py enforces the 'requires' and 'forbids' lists against product screens.

safeguards.name: Education, never prescribing
safeguards.statement: Explains options and lets a person record their own plan. Never selects a medicine or changes a dose.

safeguards.name: No dosing advice
safeguards.statement: Glucose and medication content is educational. It never tells a person what to take or how much.

safeguards.name: Screening is a prompt, not a diagnosis
safeguards.statement: Validated instruments are used to prompt someone to seek help. A score is never presented as a condition.

safeguards.name: Awareness only
safeguards.statement: Describes what screening exists and how to raise it. The product does not screen.

safeguards.name: No clinical risk score
safeguards.statement: Helps a person understand their own risk factors without presenting a calculated clinical assessment.

safeguards.name: No result interpretation
safeguards.statement: Lab values are stored and trended. The product does not say what a value means clinically.

safeguards.name: Reports, not measurements
safeguards.statement: Ratings describe how someone felt. The product is explicit that these are self-reports.

safeguards.name: A number can mean call someone
safeguards.statement: Where a reading may be dangerous, the product says to contact a clinician rather than log and continue.

safeguards.name: Crisis routing comes first
safeguards.statement: Emergency and crisis routes are designed before anything else and are never reordered, collapsed or filtered.

safeguards.name: Distress reaches a qualified person
safeguards.statement: A distress signal never terminates at a non-clinical coach. Routing is configured per program by clinical leadership.

safeguards.name: Sensitive notifications off by default
safeguards.statement: A lock screen shows that a reminder exists, never what it is about.

safeguards.name: Export and deletion
safeguards.statement: Data can be exported and deleted, with deletion actually completed rather than hidden.

safeguards.name: Nothing shared by default
safeguards.statement: Readings and history go to a clinician only when the person chooses, after previewing what is sent.

safeguards.name: A slip is an event, not a reset
safeguards.statement: A lapse is recorded in history. It never zeroes a counter, streak or progress value.

safeguards.name: No calorie or macro targets
safeguards.statement: Nutrition support does not depend on tracking every meal and sets no numeric intake target.

safeguards.name: No weight streaks
safeguards.statement: Weight is never gamified, streaked or compared between people.

safeguards.name: Disordered eating guard
safeguards.statement: Where a person shows signs of disordered eating, numeric targets and tracking prompts are withdrawn, not tightened.

safeguards.name: The person owns the record
safeguards.statement: One place to see what has been done and what is due, exportable and deletable by the person it describes.

safeguards.name: Supporters help, not watch
safeguards.statement: A family member sees what the person agreed to share. Location, messages and continuous monitoring are out of scope.

safeguards.name: Decisions stay with the person
safeguards.statement: A supporter can assist without taking the person's decisions away from them.
